name: Hezrul's Head
summary: At Lushwater Oasis, Hezrul Bloodmark leads the Kolkar centaur in the Barrens. His head is carried to Regthar Deathgate west of the Crossroads as proof their chieftain has fallen.

sections.title: Decapitating the Kolkar
sections.body: Hezrul Bloodmark leads his Kolkar centaur clan from Lushwater Oasis, south of the Crossroads. The Kolkar hold the Barrens' oases and threaten Horde supply routes and young settlements. Regthar Deathgate, an orc veteran charged with securing the land west of the Crossroads, sees their fierce rage but little discipline. He demands Hezrul's severed head to break the clan's command and throw its surviving fighters into disarray, weakening their attacks on the Horde.

faq.q: Who does this head belong to?
faq.answer: The head belongs to Hezrul Bloodmark, the leader of the Kolkar centaur clan in the central Barrens.
Hezrul leads his band around Lushwater Oasis, south of the Crossroads in the Barrens.
Regthar Deathgate, an orc at a military outpost on the road west of the Crossroads, wants the head as proof Hezrul has been defeated.

faq.q: Why does the Horde require his head instead of just driving him away?
faq.answer: The Horde needs certainty that Hezrul is dead. The centaur are volatile and prone to infighting, and removing their chieftain breaks their command and weakens their threat to the Crossroads.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, claiming the Kolkar chieftain's head secures vital water rights at Lushwater Oasis and protects Horde travelers crossing the Barrens.
As an orc, you may see the Kolkar as undisciplined ruffians whose fury yields to orcish battle discipline. Regthar sees the trophy as proof of martial honor.
